names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 iulie, «Sfânta Mironosiță și întocmai cu Apostolii Maria Magdalena», with the rank words left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Ιουλίου, «Αγία Μαρία η Μαγδαληνή η Μυροφόρος και Ισαπόστολος», with the rank word and the titles left off. The page's own hymn spells the byname «Μανδαληνή» in its text and «Μαγδαληνή» in its heading.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 22. јул ст. ст., „Марија Магдалина.“ — **and nothing at all had to be stripped from it**, which is rare in this wave: the heading carries no Св., no Света and no rank word, so the form is the heading entire, less its full stop. The by-name is kept by §6 and is load-bearing: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for the two words together and five sr holders for the bare «Марија». The Serbian vernacular differs from the Greek Μαρία and the Romanian Maria Magdalena this folder already holds, and nothing is transliterated.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 iulie — «Sfânta Mironosiță și întocmai cu Apostolii Maria Magdalena»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ας Ιουλίου — «Αγία Μαρία η Μαγδαληνή η Μυροφόρος και Ισαπόστολος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and its verse names the day too: «Δευτερίῃ Μαρίη μύσεν εἰκάδι Μαγδαληνή». The woman is the folder's own, and the Greek listing gives her the same two titles the Romanian does, myrrh-bearer and equal to the apostles. The page adds what the Romanian life did not: her town, «καταγόταν από τα Μάγδαλα, πόλη που βρίσκεται δυτικά της θάλασσας της Γαλιλαίας»; her burial «στην είσοδο της σπηλιάς, όπου αργότερα εκοιμήθησαν οι επτά παίδες εν Εφέσω», the seven youths having no folder in the corpus and so no link; and a list of relics — the right hand at Dionysiou, the left incorrupt at Simonopetra, part of the left foot at Esphigmenou, portions at Saint George Pheneos in Corinthia and the Forty Martyrs of Sparta, at the Lateran in Rome, at the basilica of Saint Maximin at Marseille and at the church of the same name the page spells «Vezelau» in France. It gives no year anywhere, so no `dates` are proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints three hymn texts and two are taken, the Ἀπολυτίκιον and the Κοντάκιον, both of which name her; the Οἶκος is left out because the schema holds a troparion or a kontakion and nothing else. The apolytikion's text reads «Σεμνὴ Μανδαληνή» for Μαγδαληνή, and that is the page's own reading, copied unchanged.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.08.2026 (22. јул ст. ст.) — „Марија Магдалина.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (§4). **THE HEADING CARRIES NO RANK WORD AT ALL** — not Св., not Света, nothing — so nothing whatever is read off it into `types`, and the folder’s `equal-to-the-apostles` is untouched. **The two rank words are in the BODY’s first sentence**, „Мироносица равноапостолна.“, a myrrh-bearer equal to the apostles: the second is the type the folder already holds, confirmed from a third book, and the first is `myrrh-bearer`, **for which this corpus has no type at all** — a standing decision, not re-asked here. A rank read out of a body is not written in any case. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE FIELD IS AND STAYS ABSENT.** This folder has no `dates` object: neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave a year. This entry gives none either — its one number, «404», belongs to the next entry’s translation of relics and not to her. Nothing is written and nothing is inferred from Tiberius, because an emperor is no source for a year. **NO FOLD, AND §6 IS WHY.** `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Марија Магдалина» and `sr-foldpred.mjs` `new key, other holders: 0 (none)`. **The bare «Марија», by contrast, is held in sr by FIVE folders** — `maria-of-caesarea`, `mary-called-marinos`, `mary-of-tarsus`, `mary-sister-of-lazarus` and `mary-wife-of-xenophon` — so the by-name the heading gives is the whole of what keeps this form out of a six-folder fold, and §6 earns its keep again. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS THE RICHEST SINGLE ENTRY OF THIS RANGE. „Родом из места Магдале, украј језера Генисаретског, из племена Исахарова.“ — from the place of Magdala by the lake of Gennesaret, **out of the tribe of Issachar**, which neither other book in this folder says. „Била је мучена од седам злих духова, од којих ју ослободи Господ Исус и учини здравом.“, tormented by seven evil spirits from which the Lord Jesus freed her. „Под крстом на Голготи стајала је и Магдалина, и горко туговала заједно са Пресветом Богородицом.“, she stood under the cross on Golgotha and grieved bitterly together with the Most Holy Theotokos. „По смрти Господа она је три пут посетила гроб Његов. А када Господ васкрсе, она Га је два пута видела: једном сама она, а други пут са осталим женама Мироносицама.“ — **she visited the tomb THREE TIMES and saw the risen Lord TWICE, once alone and once with the other myrrh-bearing women**, which is a count no other book here gives. „Путовала у Рим, изашла пред ћесара Тиберија, и предајући му јајце црвено обојено, поздравила га речима: Христос воскресе!“ — **she travelled to Rome, came before Caesar Tiberius, and handing him an egg dyed red greeted him with the words «Christ is risen»**. „У исто време оптужила ћесару Пилата за његову неправедну осуду Господа Исуса. Њену тужбу ћесар је примио, и Пилата преместио из Јерусалима у Галију, где је овај неправедни судија у немилости царској и у тешкој болести скончао.“ — at the same time she accused Pilate before Caesar for his unjust condemnation of the Lord Jesus, Caesar received the complaint and **moved Pilate from Jerusalem to Gaul, where that unjust judge ended in the emperor’s disfavour and in a grievous sickness**. „По том вратила се из Рима у Ефес ка светом Јовану Богослову, коме је помагала у делу проповедања Јеванђеља.“, she returned to Ephesus to John the Theologian and helped him in the preaching, and „Са великом љубављу према васкрсломе Господу и са великом ревношћу јављала је она Јеванђеље свету као прави Христов апостол.“, proclaimed the Gospel as a true apostle of Christ. „Скончала мирно у Ефесу, и сахрањена, по предању, у оној истој пећини, у којој и седам младића, чудотворно успаваних на стотине година, по том оживелих, па онда умрлих (в. 4. август).“ — **buried by tradition in the same cave as the seven youths wonderfully put to sleep for hundreds of years**, with the entry’s own cross-reference to the 4 August. „Мошти св. Магдалине пренете су доцније у Цариград.“, her relics later translated to Constantinople; and „Близу Гетсиманског врта налази се диван руски храм посвећен св. Марији Магдалини.“, a fine Russian church near the garden of Gethsemane dedicated to her. **ONE RECIPROCAL SUPPLIED AND FOUR THINGS REFUSED A ROW.** `john-the-theologian` is on this folder already and the entry makes him the man she worked with at Ephesus; `proseprobe.mjs` reported him as **OWES back**, so the reverse row goes in with this batch and nothing else in that folder is touched. **THE SEVEN YOUTHS OF EPHESUS GET NO ROW, AND THE REASON IS NOT ONLY RULING 3**: the corpus holds `antoninus-of-ephesus`, `dionysius-of-ephesus`, `exacustodianus-of-ephesus`, `iamblichus-of-ephesus`, `john-of-ephesus`, `martinian-of-ephesus` and `maximilian-of-ephesus`, which is a company of seven of Ephesus; but the entry names not one of them, says only «seven youths», and **sends the reader to the Julian 4 August, which is another reader’s range in this wave and not this one’s to write into**. A shared grave is not a relation and an identification off a count is not an identification. Named for the author. **PILATE AND TIBERIUS GET NOTHING**: `ls saints | grep -iE ’^pilate|^tiberius’` returns nothing at all. **THE RUSSIAN CHURCH AT GETHSEMANE IS A DEDICATION** and a dedication is not a relation. No `office`. No `locations`: Magdala, the lake of Gennesaret, Golgotha, Rome, Jerusalem, Gaul, Ephesus, Constantinople and Gethsemane are nine places in one entry and not one is written as a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. **THE DAY’S SECOND ENTRY IS REFUSED WHOLE AND IS THE FIRST §1 REFUSAL OF THIS RANGE.** Its heading is „Свешт. муч. Фока.“, which names a person and a rank, so it is not a §5 refusal on the heading. It is refused because `phocas-of-sinope` **already carries a venerated `serbian` row, on the Julian 22 September, written off this very book**, with the identical bare sr form «Фока» — and §1 says a saint of the range who already has a venerated `serbian` row from another day is left alone and is a reading for the report, never a draft. **AND THE BODY SAYS SO ITSELF, WHICH NO EARLIER REFUSAL OF THIS WAVE HAS HAD**: „Главно је празновање овога светитеља 22. септембра, где се и налази опис његовог живота и страдања.“ — the chief celebration of this saint is the 22 September, where the account of his life and his passion is to be found. **The day’s own content is a translation of relics**, „Пренос моштију из Понта у Цариград око 404. год.“, from Pontus to Constantinople about the year 404, which §5 makes a feast and not a folder in any case. So the entry is refused on two independent grounds and `phocas-of-sinope` is not touched: no row, no name form, no `related`, no paragraph. **What the 22 July entry adds, and it is lost unless it is written down somewhere**: „Још се у данашњи дан спомиње и једно чудо овога светитеља. Неки човек, Понтин, беше ухваћен од Арапа. Арапи га оковаше, везаше му руке на леђа и тако оставише да умре.“, a man named Понтин taken by the Arabs, chained, his hands bound behind his back and left to die; lying face down on the ground and unable to stir he cried „Лежећи потрбушке на земљи и не могући се маћи завапи Понтин: „свети мучениче Фоко, помилуј ме и спаси ме!““, holy martyr Phocas, have mercy on me and save me; „Рекавши то он заспи, и у сну виде светитеља Фоку, како му се приближи, дохвати га руком и рече: „опрашта ти Господ Исус Христос!““, he fell asleep as he said it and saw the saint come near, take him by the hand and say **the Lord Jesus Christ forgives you**; and „Када се човек пробуди нађе се слободан и разрешен од свих веза. Устаде, дакле, и оде дому своме и узе св. Фоку за своју домаћу славу.“ — he woke free and loosed from every bond, went home, **and took Saint Phocas for his household slava**. The second-day note that this would take under BRIEF.md’s Ruling is named for the author and is not written here. `phocas-the-gardener`, `phocas-2-august` and `phocas-18-december` are three further Phocas folders and none of them is this man either.

hymns.text: Lui Hristos, Cel Ce pentru noi S-a născut din Fecioară, Cinstită Maria Magdalena, ai urmat şi ai păzit îndreptările şi legile Lui. Pentru aceasta, astăzi, preasfinţită pomenirea ta prăznuind, te lăudăm cu credinţă şi te cinstim cu dragoste.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfintei Mironosițe, întocmai cu Apostolii, Maria Magdalena», Glasul 1

english.text: Christ, who for our sake was born of the Virgin, you followed, honoured Mary Magdalene, and you kept His ordinances and His laws. Therefore, keeping today your most holy memory, we praise you in faith and honour you with love.

hymns.text: Χριστῷ τῷ δι᾽ ἡμᾶς, ἐκ Παρθένου τεχθέντι, Σεμνὴ Μανδαληνή, ἠκολούθεις Μαρία, αὐτοῦ τὰ δικαιώματα, καὶ τοὺς νόμους φυλάττουσα, ὅθεν σήμερον, τὴν παναγίαν σου μνήμην, ἑορτάζοντες, ἀνευφημοῦμέν σε πίστει, καὶ πόθῳ γεραίρομεν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Τὸν τάφον σου Σωτὴρ — the first of the three hymn texts on the page of «Αγία Μαρία η Μαγδαληνή η Μυροφόρος και Ισαπόστολος», and it names her. Its «Μανδαληνή» for Μαγδαληνή is the page's own reading

english.text: Christ, who was born of the Virgin for our sake — him you followed, honourable Mary of Magdala, keeping his ordinances and his laws; and so today, keeping your all-holy memory, we praise you in faith and honour you with longing.

hymns.text: Ὁ ὑπερούσιος Θεὸς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, μετὰ σαρκὸς ἐπιφοιτῶν Μυροφόρε, σὲ ἀληθῆ Μαθήτριαν προσήκατο, ὅλην σου τὴν ἔφεσιν, πρὸς αὐτὸν κεκτημένην, ὅθεν καὶ ἰάματα, ἀπετέλεσας πλεῖστα· καὶ μεταστάσα νῦν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, ὑπὲρ τοῦ κόσμου πρεσβεύεις ἑκάστοτε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθείς — the second of the three hymn texts on the page of «Αγία Μαρία η Μαγδαληνή η Μυροφόρος και Ισαπόστολος», and it addresses her as myrrh-bearer

english.text: God who is above all being, coming into the world in the flesh, received you, myrrh-bearer, as a true disciple, since you had set all your desire upon him; and so you worked very many healings. And now, having passed over into the heavens, you intercede at every hour for the world.
